purpose: Conservative temporal/network contextualization of M10.3 exact TXID correlations.
score_semantics: Contextual evidence score in [0,1], not a probability and not proof of illicit activity.
notes: M10.4 operates only on supplied network timestamps and exact TXID relationships.
Elliptic++ time_step is retained as dataset-relative ordered context.
No conversion from time_step to wall-clock time is performed.
Temporal evidence does not establish IP ownership or transaction authorship.
Current network observations are synthetic pipeline-validation data.
